blocks.content: Emergency operation and test operation
Emergency Operation: Use this operation only when the remote controller is defective or lost.
When the emergency operation switch is pressed, the" Pi "sound is heard once, which means the start of this operation.
In this operation, the system automatically selects the operation modes, cooling or fan or heat, according to the room temperature.
When machine is running in emergency, the set value of temperature and wind speed couldn't be altered; meanwhile, it can't operate for dehumidifying or under timing mode.
Test operation:
